zh: 把所有 pref 加起来，每个原元素恰好被加了 N-1 次（只有它自己那一项漏掉它）。
所以原数组总和 T 等于 pref 之和除以 N-1，而 pref[i] 正是 T 减去 a[i]，反过来 a[i] = T - pref[i]。
读入后求 pref 的总和（最多约 10^14，用 64 位整数），除以 N-1 得到 T（题目保证能整除），然后按原顺序输出每个 T - pref[i]。
en: Add up all the pref values: every original element is counted exactly N-1 times, since only its own entry leaves it out.
So the total T of the original array is sum(pref) divided by N-1, and since pref[i] is T minus a[i], we get a[i] = T - pref[i].
Read the input, sum pref in a 64-bit integer (it can reach about 10^14), divide by N-1 to get T (the division is guaranteed to be exact), then output T - pref[i] for each index in the original order.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Each original element is counted N-1 times, so the total is T = sum(pref)/(N-1), and each answer is T-pref[i].

## Correctness

Adding up all the equations determines T uniquely, and subtracting term by term recovers the array uniquely; substituting back verifies the original equations. The independent small-input check instead derives the first element from p[0]-p[i]=a[i]-a[0], then directly recomputes each sum that excludes the element itself and verifies it.

## Complexity

Time O(N), O(1) besides input and output.
